evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and adds the setprunelock and listprunelocks RPC commands in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
rationale: Adds RPC endpoints to manage prune locks so external software and unloaded wallets do not lose blocks required for rescans. Reviewers noted this directly solves a gap where external wallets building on Bitcoin Core risk blocks being pruned away during temporary downtime or when unloaded.
